title: A sandbox stage's report: report.json, written last by the Claude operator
description: One entry per test of the stage, in the order they were given. The host reads this file, not the session's exit code, and a report that does not fit this schema counts as no report. acceptance/OPERATOR.md shows it to the operator.
$comment: Only the keywords acceptance/schema-lite.mjs checks are used here.

id.description: The step: the first word of its test's title.

saw.description: One or two sentences on what the screenshots and the facts file showed. It describes; it does not quote an answer.

evidence.description: The files the verdict rests on, by bare name, as they stand in the stage's output folder.

reruns.description: How many times the step was run again: 0, or 1.

notes.description: Anything a product manager would call broken on a screen, or the empty string.
